FJI.name: Fiji
FJI.climate: tropical marine; only slight seasonal temperature variation

TZA.name: Tanzania
TZA.climate: varies from tropical along coast to temperate in highlands
TZA.terrain: plains along coast; central plateau; highlands in north, south

SAH.name: Western Sahara
SAH.climate: hot, dry desert; rain is rare; cold offshore air currents produce fog and heavy dew
SAH.terrain: mostly low, flat desert with large areas of rocky or sandy surfaces rising to small mountains in south and northeast

CAN.name: Canada
CAN.climate: varies from temperate in south to subarctic and arctic in north
CAN.terrain: mostly plains with mountains in west, lowlands in southeast

USA.name: United States
USA.climate: mostly temperate, but tropical in Hawaii and Florida, arctic in Alaska, semiarid in the great plains west of the Mississippi River, and arid in the Great Basin of the southwest; low winter temperatures in the northwest are ameliorated occasionally in January and February by warm chinook winds from the eastern slopes of the Rocky Mountains
USA.terrain: vast central plain, mountains in west, hills and low mountains in east; rugged mountains and broad river valleys in Alaska; rugged, volcanic topography in Hawaii

KAZ.name: Kazakhstan
KAZ.climate: continental, cold winters and hot summers, arid and semiarid
KAZ.terrain: vast flat steppe extending from the Volga in the west to the Altai Mountains in the east and from the plains of western Siberia in the north to oases and deserts of Central Asia in the south

UZB.name: Uzbekistan
UZB.climate: mostly mid-latitude desert, long, hot summers, mild winters; semiarid grassland in east
UZB.terrain: mostly flat-to-rolling sandy desert with dunes; broad, flat intensely irrigated river valleys along course of Amu Darya, Syr Darya (Sirdaryo), and Zaravshan; Fergana Valley in east surrounded by mountainous Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan; shrinking Aral Sea in west

PNG.name: Papua New Guinea
PNG.climate: tropical; northwest monsoon (December to March), southeast monsoon (May to October); slight seasonal temperature variation
PNG.terrain: mostly mountains with coastal lowlands and rolling foothills

IDN.name: Indonesia
IDN.climate: tropical; hot, humid; more moderate in highlands
IDN.terrain: mostly coastal lowlands; larger islands have interior mountains

ARG.name: Argentina
ARG.climate: mostly temperate; arid in southeast; subantarctic in southwest
ARG.terrain: rich plains of the Pampas in northern half, flat to rolling plateau of Patagonia in south, rugged Andes along western border

CHL.name: Chile
CHL.climate: temperate; desert in north; Mediterranean in central region; cool and damp in south
CHL.terrain: low coastal mountains, fertile central valley, rugged Andes in east

COD.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
COD.climate: tropical; hot and humid in equatorial river basin; cooler and drier in southern highlands; cooler and wetter in eastern highlands; north of Equator - wet season (April to October), dry season (December to February); south of Equator - wet season (November to March), dry season (April to October)
COD.terrain: vast central basin is a low-lying plateau; mountains in east

SOM.name: Somalia
SOM.climate: principally desert; northeast monsoon (December to February), moderate temperatures in north and hot in south; southwest monsoon (May to October), torrid in the north and hot in the south, irregular rainfall, hot and humid periods (tangambili) between monsoons
SOM.terrain: mostly flat to undulating plateau rising to hills in north

KEN.name: Kenya
KEN.climate: varies from tropical along coast to arid in interior
KEN.terrain: low plains rise to central highlands bisected by Great Rift Valley; fertile plateau in west

SDN.name: Sudan
SDN.climate: hot and dry; arid desert; rainy season varies by region (April to November)
SDN.terrain: generally flat, featureless plain; desert dominates the north

TCD.name: Chad
TCD.climate: tropical in south, desert in north
TCD.terrain: broad, arid plains in center, desert in north, mountains in northwest, lowlands in south

HTI.name: Haiti
HTI.climate: tropical; semiarid where mountains in east cut off trade winds

DOM.name: Dominican Republic
DOM.climate: tropical maritime; little seasonal temperature variation; seasonal variation in rainfall
DOM.terrain: rugged highlands and mountains interspersed with fertile valleys

RUS.name: Russian Federation
RUS.climate: ranges from steppes in the south through humid continental in much of European Russia; subarctic in Siberia to tundra climate in the polar north; winters vary from cool along Black Sea coast to frigid in Siberia; summers vary from warm in the steppes to cool along Arctic coast
RUS.terrain: broad plain with low hills west of Urals; vast coniferous forest and tundra in Siberia; uplands and mountains along southern border regions

BHS.name: Bahamas
BHS.climate: tropical marine; moderated by warm waters of Gulf Stream
BHS.terrain: long, flat coral formations with some low rounded hills

FLK.name: Falkland Islands / Malvinas
FLK.climate: cold marine; strong westerly winds, cloudy, humid; rain occurs on more than half of days in year; average annual rainfall is 60 cm in Stanley; occasional snow all year, except in January and February, but typically does not accumulate
FLK.terrain: rocky, hilly, mountainous with some boggy, undulating plains

NOR.name: Norway
NOR.climate: temperate along coast, modified by North Atlantic Current; colder interior with increased precipitation and colder summers; rainy year-round on west coast
NOR.terrain: glaciated; mostly high plateaus and rugged mountains broken by fertile valleys; small, scattered plains; coastline deeply indented by fjords; arctic tundra in north

GRL.name: Greenland
GRL.climate: arctic to subarctic; cool summers, cold winters
GRL.terrain: flat to gradually sloping icecap covers all but a narrow, mountainous, barren, rocky coast

ATF.name: French Southern and Antarctic Lands
ATF.climate: Ile Amsterdam et Ile Saint-Paul: oceanic with persistent westerly winds and high humidity ; ; Iles Crozet: windy, cold, wet, and cloudy ; ; Iles Kerguelen: oceanic, cold, overcast, windy ; ; Iles Eparses: tropical
ATF.terrain: Ile Amsterdam (Ile Amsterdam et Ile Saint-Paul): a volcanic island with steep coastal cliffs; the center floor of the volcano is a large plateau; ; Ile Saint-Paul (Ile Amsterdam et Ile Saint-Paul): triangular in shape, the island is the top of a volcano, rocky with steep cliffs on the eastern side; has active thermal springs; ; Iles Crozet: a large archipelago formed from the Crozet Plateau is divided into two groups of islands; ; Iles Kerguelen: the interior of the large island of Ile Kerguelen is composed of high mountains, hills, valleys, and plains with peninsulas stretching off its coasts ; ; Bassas da India (Iles Eparses): atoll, awash at high tide; shallow (15 m) lagoon; ; Europa Island, Glorioso Islands, Juan de Nova Island: low, flat, and sandy; ; Tromelin Island (Iles Eparses): low, flat, sandy; likely volcanic seamount

TLS.name: Timor-Leste
TLS.climate: tropical; hot, humid; distinct rainy and dry seasons

ZAF.name: South Africa
ZAF.climate: mostly semiarid; subtropical along east coast; sunny days, cool nights
ZAF.terrain: vast interior plateau rimmed by rugged hills and narrow coastal plain

LSO.name: Lesotho
LSO.climate: temperate; cool to cold, dry winters; hot, wet summers
LSO.terrain: mostly highland with plateaus, hills, and mountains

MEX.name: Mexico
MEX.terrain: high, rugged mountains; low coastal plains; high plateaus; desert

URY.name: Uruguay
URY.climate: warm temperate; freezing temperatures almost unknown
URY.terrain: mostly rolling plains and low hills; fertile coastal lowland

BRA.name: Brazil
BRA.climate: mostly tropical, but temperate in south
BRA.terrain: mostly flat to rolling lowlands in north; some plains, hills, mountains, and narrow coastal belt

BOL.name: Bolivia
BOL.climate: varies with altitude; humid and tropical to cold and semiarid
BOL.terrain: rugged Andes Mountains with a highland plateau (Altiplano), hills, lowland plains of the Amazon Basin

PER.name: Peru
PER.climate: varies from tropical in east to dry desert in west; temperate to frigid in Andes
PER.terrain: western coastal plain (costa), high and rugged Andes in center (sierra), eastern lowland jungle of Amazon Basin (selva)

COL.name: Colombia
COL.climate: tropical along coast and eastern plains; cooler in highlands
COL.terrain: flat coastal lowlands, central highlands, high Andes Mountains, eastern lowland plains (Llanos)

PAN.name: Panama
PAN.climate: tropical maritime; hot, humid, cloudy; prolonged rainy season (May to January), short dry season (January to May)
PAN.terrain: interior mostly steep, rugged mountains with dissected, upland plains; coastal plains with rolling hills

CRI.name: Costa Rica
CRI.climate: tropical and subtropical; dry season (December to April); rainy season (May to November); cooler in highlands
CRI.terrain: coastal plains separated by rugged mountains including over 100 volcanic cones, of which several are major active volcanoes

NIC.name: Nicaragua
NIC.climate: tropical in lowlands, cooler in highlands
NIC.terrain: extensive Atlantic coastal plains rising to central interior mountains; narrow Pacific coastal plain interrupted by volcanoes

HND.name: Honduras
HND.climate: subtropical in lowlands, temperate in mountains
HND.terrain: mostly mountains in interior, narrow coastal plains

SLV.name: El Salvador
SLV.climate: tropical; rainy season (May to October); dry season (November to April); tropical on coast; temperate in uplands
SLV.terrain: mostly mountains with narrow coastal belt and central plateau

GTM.name: Guatemala
GTM.climate: tropical; hot, humid in lowlands; cooler in highlands
GTM.terrain: two east-west trending mountain chains divide the country into three regions: the mountainous highlands, the Pacific coast south of mountains, and the vast northern Peten lowlands

BLZ.name: Belize
BLZ.climate: tropical; very hot and humid; rainy season (May to November); dry season (February to May)
BLZ.terrain: flat, swampy coastal plain; low mountains in south

VEN.name: Venezuela
VEN.climate: tropical; hot, humid; more moderate in highlands
VEN.terrain: Andes Mountains and Maracaibo Lowlands in northwest; central plains (llanos); Guiana Highlands in southeast

GUY.name: Guyana
GUY.climate: tropical; hot, humid, moderated by northeast trade winds; two rainy seasons (May to August, November to January)
GUY.terrain: mostly rolling highlands; low coastal plain; savanna in south

SUR.name: Suriname
SUR.terrain: mostly rolling hills; narrow coastal plain with swamps

FRA.name: France
FRA.climate: metropolitan France: generally cool winters and mild summers, but mild winters and hot summers along the Mediterranean; occasional strong, cold, dry, north-to-northwesterly wind known as the mistral
FRA.terrain: metropolitan France: mostly flat plains or gently rolling hills in north and west; remainder is mountainous, especially Pyrenees in south, Alps in east; ; French Guiana: low-lying coastal plains rising to hills and small mountains; ; Guadeloupe: Basse-Terre is volcanic in origin with interior mountains; Grande-Terre is low limestone formation; most of the seven other islands are volcanic in origin; ; Martinique: mountainous with indented coastline; dormant volcano; ; Mayotte: generally undulating, with deep ravines and ancient volcanic peaks; ; Reunion: mostly rugged and mountainous; fertile lowlands along coast

ECU.name: Ecuador
ECU.climate: tropical along coast, becoming cooler inland at higher elevations; tropical in Amazonian jungle lowlands
ECU.terrain: coastal plain (costa), inter-Andean central highlands (sierra), and flat to rolling eastern jungle (oriente)

PRI.name: Puerto Rico
PRI.climate: tropical marine, mild; little seasonal temperature variation
PRI.terrain: mostly mountains with coastal plain in north; precipitous mountains to the sea on west coast; sandy beaches along most coastal areas

JAM.name: Jamaica
JAM.terrain: mostly mountains, with narrow, discontinuous coastal plain

CUB.name: Cuba
CUB.climate: tropical; moderated by trade winds; dry season (November to April); rainy season (May to October)
CUB.terrain: mostly flat to rolling plains, with rugged hills and mountains in the southeast

ZWE.name: Zimbabwe
ZWE.climate: tropical; moderated by altitude; rainy season (November to March)
ZWE.terrain: mostly high plateau with higher central plateau (high veld); mountains in east

BWA.name: Botswana
BWA.climate: semiarid; warm winters and hot summers
BWA.terrain: predominantly flat to gently rolling tableland; Kalahari Desert in southwest

NAM.name: Namibia
NAM.climate: desert; hot, dry; rainfall sparse and erratic
NAM.terrain: mostly high plateau; Namib Desert along coast; Kalahari Desert in east

SEN.name: Senegal
SEN.climate: tropical; hot, humid; rainy season (May to November) has strong southeast winds; dry season (December to April) dominated by hot, dry, harmattan wind
SEN.terrain: generally low, rolling, plains rising to foothills in southeast

MLI.name: Mali
MLI.climate: subtropical to arid; hot and dry (February to June); rainy, humid, and mild (June to November); cool and dry (November to February)
MLI.terrain: mostly flat to rolling northern plains covered by sand; savanna in south, rugged hills in northeast

MRT.name: Mauritania
MRT.terrain: mostly barren, flat plains of the Sahara; some central hills

BEN.name: Benin
BEN.climate: tropical; hot, humid in south; semiarid in north
BEN.terrain: mostly flat to undulating plain; some hills and low mountains

NER.name: Niger
NER.climate: desert; mostly hot, dry, dusty; tropical in extreme south
NER.terrain: predominately desert plains and sand dunes; flat to rolling plains in south; hills in north

NGA.name: Nigeria
NGA.climate: varies; equatorial in south, tropical in center, arid in north
NGA.terrain: southern lowlands merge into central hills and plateaus; mountains in southeast, plains in north

CMR.name: Cameroon
CMR.climate: varies with terrain, from tropical along coast to semiarid and hot in north
CMR.terrain: diverse, with coastal plain in southwest, dissected plateau in center, mountains in west, plains in north

TGO.name: Togo
TGO.climate: tropical; hot, humid in south; semiarid in north
TGO.terrain: gently rolling savanna in north; central hills; southern plateau; low coastal plain with extensive lagoons and marshes

GHA.name: Ghana
GHA.climate: tropical; warm and comparatively dry along southeast coast; hot and humid in southwest; hot and dry in north
GHA.terrain: mostly low plains with dissected plateau in south-central area

CIV.name: C\xF4te d'Ivoire
CIV.climate: tropical along coast, semiarid in far north; three seasons - warm and dry (November to March), hot and dry (March to May), hot and wet (June to October)
CIV.terrain: mostly flat to undulating plains; mountains in northwest

GIN.name: Guinea
GIN.climate: generally hot and humid; monsoonal-type rainy season (June to November) with southwesterly winds; dry season (December to May) with northeasterly harmattan winds
GIN.terrain: generally flat coastal plain, hilly to mountainous interior

GNB.name: Guinea-Bissau
GNB.climate: tropical; generally hot and humid; monsoonal-type rainy season (June to November) with southwesterly winds; dry season (December to May) with northeasterly harmattan winds
GNB.terrain: mostly low-lying coastal plain with a deeply indented estuarine coastline rising to savanna in east; numerous off-shore islands including the Arquipelago Dos Bijagos consisting of 18 main islands and many small islets

LBR.name: Liberia
LBR.climate: tropical; hot, humid; dry winters with hot days and cool to cold nights; wet, cloudy summers with frequent heavy showers
LBR.terrain: mostly flat to rolling coastal plains rising to rolling plateau and low mountains in northeast

SLE.name: Sierra Leone
SLE.climate: tropical; hot, humid; summer rainy season (May to December); winter dry season (December to April)
SLE.terrain: coastal belt of mangrove swamps, wooded hill country, upland plateau, mountains in east

BFA.name: Burkina Faso
BFA.climate: three climate zones including a hot tropical savanna with a short rainy season in the southern half, a tropical hot semi-arid steppe climate typical of the Sahel region in the northern half, and small area of hot desert in the very north of the country bordering the Sahara Desert
BFA.terrain: mostly flat to dissected, undulating plains; hills in the west and southeast; occupies an extensive plateau with savanna that is grassy in the north and gradually gives way to sparse forests in the south

CAF.name: Central African Republic
CAF.climate: tropical; hot, dry winters; mild to hot, wet summers
CAF.terrain: vast, flat to rolling plateau; scattered hills in northeast and southwest

COG.name: Republic of the Congo
COG.climate: tropical; rainy season (March to June); dry season (June to October); persistent high temperatures and humidity; particularly enervating climate astride the Equator
COG.terrain: coastal plain, southern basin, central plateau, northern basin

GAB.name: Gabon
GAB.terrain: narrow coastal plain; hilly interior; savanna in east and south

GNQ.name: Equatorial Guinea
GNQ.terrain: coastal plains rise to interior hills; islands are volcanic

ZMB.name: Zambia
ZMB.climate: tropical; modified by altitude; rainy season (October to April)
ZMB.terrain: mostly high plateau with some hills and mountains

MWI.name: Malawi
MWI.climate: sub-tropical; rainy season (November to May); dry season (May to November)
MWI.terrain: narrow elongated plateau with rolling plains, rounded hills, some mountains

MOZ.name: Mozambique
MOZ.terrain: mostly coastal lowlands, uplands in center, high plateaus in northwest, mountains in west

SWZ.name: Kingdom of eSwatini
SWZ.climate: varies from tropical to near temperate
SWZ.terrain: mostly mountains and hills; some moderately sloping plains

AGO.name: Angola
AGO.climate: semiarid in south and along coast to Luanda; north has cool, dry season (May to October) and hot, rainy season (November to April)
AGO.terrain: narrow coastal plain rises abruptly to vast interior plateau

BDI.name: Burundi
BDI.climate: equatorial; high plateau with considerable altitude variation (772 m to 2,670 m above sea level); average annual temperature varies with altitude from 23 to 17 degrees Celsius but is generally moderate; average annual rainfall is about 150 cm with two wet seasons (February to May and September to November) and two dry seasons (June to August and December to January)
BDI.terrain: hilly and mountainous, dropping to a plateau in east, some plains

ISR.name: Israel
ISR.climate: temperate; hot and dry in southern and eastern desert areas
ISR.terrain: Negev desert in the south; low coastal plain; central mountains; Jordan Rift Valley

LBN.name: Lebanon
LBN.climate: Mediterranean; mild to cool, wet winters with hot, dry summers; the Lebanon Mountains experience heavy winter snows
LBN.terrain: narrow coastal plain; El Beqaa (Bekaa Valley) separates Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon Mountains

MDG.name: Madagascar
MDG.climate: tropical along coast, temperate inland, arid in south
MDG.terrain: narrow coastal plain, high plateau and mountains in center

PSX.name: Palestine
PSX.climate: Mediterranean conditions dominate the West Bank: hot, dry summers and cool, wet winters; the southern desert is much drier. Gaza has a warm coastal Mediterranean climate.
PSX.terrain: A varied region of central highlands, the Jordan Rift Valley and Dead Sea depression, plus Gaza’s narrow low coastal plain.

GMB.name: The Gambia
GMB.climate: tropical; hot, rainy season (June to November); cooler, dry season (November to May)
GMB.terrain: flood plain of the Gambia River flanked by some low hills

TUN.name: Tunisia
TUN.climate: temperate in north with mild, rainy winters and hot, dry summers; desert in south
TUN.terrain: mountains in north; hot, dry central plain; semiarid south merges into the Sahara

DZA.name: Algeria
DZA.climate: arid to semiarid; mild, wet winters with hot, dry summers along coast; drier with cold winters and hot summers on high plateau; sirocco is a hot, dust/sand-laden wind especially common in summer
DZA.terrain: mostly high plateau and desert; Atlas Mountains in the far north and Hoggar Mountains in the south; narrow, discontinuous coastal plain

JOR.name: Jordan
JOR.climate: mostly arid desert; rainy season in west (November to April)
JOR.terrain: mostly arid desert plateau; a great north-south geological rift along the west of the country is the dominant topographical feature and includes the Jordan River Valley, the Dead Sea, and the Jordanian Highlands

ARE.name: United Arab Emirates
ARE.terrain: flat, barren coastal plain merging into rolling sand dunes of vast desert; mountains in east

QAT.name: Qatar
QAT.climate: arid; mild, pleasant winters; very hot, humid summers

KWT.name: Kuwait
KWT.climate: dry desert; intensely hot summers; short, cool winters
KWT.terrain: flat to slightly undulating desert plain

IRQ.name: Iraq
IRQ.climate: mostly desert; mild to cool winters with dry, hot, cloudless summers; northern mountainous regions along Iranian and Turkish borders experience cold winters with occasionally heavy snows that melt in early spring, sometimes causing extensive flooding in central and southern Iraq
IRQ.terrain: mostly broad plains; reedy marshes along Iranian border in south with large flooded areas; mountains along borders with Iran and Turkey

OMN.name: Oman
OMN.climate: dry desert; hot, humid along coast; hot, dry interior; strong southwest summer monsoon (May to September) in far south
OMN.terrain: central desert plain, rugged mountains in north and south

VUT.name: Vanuatu
VUT.climate: tropical; moderated by southeast trade winds from May to October; moderate rainfall from November to April; may be affected by cyclones from December to April
VUT.terrain: mostly mountainous islands of volcanic origin; narrow coastal plains

KHM.name: Cambodia
KHM.climate: tropical; rainy, monsoon season (May to November); dry season (December to April); little seasonal temperature variation
KHM.terrain: mostly low, flat plains; mountains in southwest and north

THA.name: Thailand
THA.climate: tropical; rainy, warm, cloudy southwest monsoon (mid-May to September); dry, cool northeast monsoon (November to mid-March); southern isthmus always hot and humid
THA.terrain: central plain; Khorat Plateau in the east; mountains elsewhere

LAO.name: Lao PDR
LAO.climate: tropical monsoon; rainy season (May to November); dry season (December to April)
LAO.terrain: mostly rugged mountains; some plains and plateaus

MMR.name: Myanmar
MMR.climate: tropical monsoon; cloudy, rainy, hot, humid summers (southwest monsoon, June to September); less cloudy, scant rainfall, mild temperatures, lower humidity during winter (northeast monsoon, December to April)
MMR.terrain: central lowlands ringed by steep, rugged highlands

VNM.name: Vietnam
VNM.climate: tropical in south; monsoonal in north with hot, rainy season (May to September) and warm, dry season (October to March)
VNM.terrain: low, flat delta in south and north; central highlands; hilly, mountainous in far north and northwest

PRK.name: Dem. Rep. Korea
PRK.climate: temperate, with rainfall concentrated in summer; long, bitter winters
PRK.terrain: mostly hills and mountains separated by deep, narrow valleys; wide coastal plains in west, discontinuous in east

KOR.name: Republic of Korea
KOR.climate: temperate, with rainfall heavier in summer than winter; cold winters
KOR.terrain: mostly hills and mountains; wide coastal plains in west and south

MNG.name: Mongolia
MNG.climate: desert; continental (large daily and seasonal temperature ranges)
MNG.terrain: vast semidesert and desert plains, grassy steppe, mountains in west and southwest; Gobi Desert in south-central

IND.name: India
IND.climate: varies from tropical monsoon in south to temperate in north
IND.terrain: upland plain (Deccan Plateau) in south, flat to rolling plain along the Ganges, deserts in west, Himalayas in north

BGD.name: Bangladesh
BGD.climate: tropical; mild winter (October to March); hot, humid summer (March to June); humid, warm rainy monsoon (June to October)
BGD.terrain: mostly flat alluvial plain; hilly in southeast

BTN.name: Bhutan
BTN.climate: varies; tropical in southern plains; cool winters and hot summers in central valleys; severe winters and cool summers in Himalayas
BTN.terrain: mostly mountainous with some fertile valleys and savanna

NPL.name: Nepal
NPL.climate: varies from cool summers and severe winters in north to subtropical summers and mild winters in south
NPL.terrain: Tarai or flat river plain of the Ganges in south; central hill region with rugged Himalayas in north

PAK.name: Pakistan
PAK.climate: mostly hot, dry desert; temperate in northwest; arctic in north
PAK.terrain: divided into three major geographic areas: the northern highlands, the Indus River plain in the center and east, and the Balochistan Plateau in the south and west

AFG.name: Afghanistan
AFG.climate: arid to semiarid; cold winters and hot summers
AFG.terrain: mostly rugged mountains; plains in north and southwest

TJK.name: Tajikistan
TJK.climate: mid-latitude continental, hot summers, mild winters; semiarid to polar in Pamir Mountains
TJK.terrain: mountainous region dominated by the Alay Mountains in the north and the Pamirs in the southeast; western Fergana Valley in north, Kofirnihon and Vakhsh Valleys in southwest

KGZ.name: Kyrgyzstan
KGZ.climate: dry continental to polar in high Tien Shan Mountains; subtropical in southwest (Fergana Valley); temperate in northern foothill zone
KGZ.terrain: peaks of the Tien Shan mountain range and associated valleys and basins encompass the entire country

TKM.name: Turkmenistan
TKM.terrain: flat-to-rolling sandy desert with dunes rising to mountains in the south; low mountains along border with Iran; borders Caspian Sea in west

IRN.name: Iran
IRN.climate: mostly arid or semiarid, subtropical along Caspian coast
IRN.terrain: rugged, mountainous rim; high, central basin with deserts, mountains; small, discontinuous plains along both coasts

SYR.name: Syria
SYR.climate: mostly desert; hot, dry, sunny summers (June to August) and mild, rainy winters (December to February) along coast; cold weather with snow or sleet periodically in Damascus
SYR.terrain: primarily semiarid and desert plateau; narrow coastal plain; mountains in west

ARM.name: Armenia
ARM.climate: highland continental, hot summers, cold winters
ARM.terrain: Armenian Highland with mountains; little forest land; fast flowing rivers; good soil in Aras River valley

SWE.name: Sweden
SWE.climate: temperate in south with cold, cloudy winters and cool, partly cloudy summers; subarctic in north
SWE.terrain: mostly flat or gently rolling lowlands; mountains in west

BLR.name: Belarus
BLR.climate: cold winters, cool and moist summers; transitional between continental and maritime

UKR.name: Ukraine
UKR.climate: temperate continental; Mediterranean only on the southern Crimean coast; precipitation disproportionately distributed, highest in west and north, lesser in east and southeast; winters vary from cool along the Black Sea to cold farther inland; warm summers across the greater part of the country, hot in the south
UKR.terrain: mostly fertile plains (steppes) and plateaus, with mountains found only in the west (the Carpathians) or in the extreme south of the Crimean Peninsula

POL.name: Poland
POL.climate: temperate with cold, cloudy, moderately severe winters with frequent precipitation; mild summers with frequent showers and thundershowers
POL.terrain: mostly flat plain; mountains along southern border

AUT.name: Austria
AUT.climate: temperate; continental, cloudy; cold winters with frequent rain and some snow in lowlands and snow in mountains; moderate summers with occasional showers
AUT.terrain: mostly mountains (Alps) in the west and south; mostly flat or gently sloping along the eastern and northern margins

HUN.name: Hungary
HUN.climate: temperate; cold, cloudy, humid winters; warm summers
HUN.terrain: mostly flat to rolling plains; hills and low mountains on the Slovakian border

MDA.name: Moldova
MDA.terrain: rolling steppe, gradual slope south to Black Sea

ROU.name: Romania
ROU.climate: temperate; cold, cloudy winters with frequent snow and fog; sunny summers with frequent showers and thunderstorms
ROU.terrain: central Transylvanian Basin is separated from the Moldavian Plateau on the east by the Eastern Carpathian Mountains and separated from the Walachian Plain on the south by the Transylvanian Alps

LTU.name: Lithuania
LTU.climate: transitional, between maritime and continental; wet, moderate winters and summers
LTU.terrain: lowland, many scattered small lakes, fertile soil

EST.name: Estonia
EST.climate: maritime; wet, moderate winters, cool summers
EST.terrain: marshy, lowlands; flat in the north, hilly in the south

DEU.name: Germany
DEU.climate: temperate and marine; cool, cloudy, wet winters and summers; occasional warm mountain (foehn) wind
DEU.terrain: lowlands in north, uplands in center, Bavarian Alps in south

BGR.name: Bulgaria
BGR.climate: temperate; cold, damp winters; hot, dry summers
BGR.terrain: mostly mountains with lowlands in north and southeast

GRC.name: Greece
GRC.climate: temperate; mild, wet winters; hot, dry summers
GRC.terrain: mountainous with ranges extending into the sea as peninsulas or chains of islands

TUR.name: Turkey
TUR.climate: temperate; hot, dry summers with mild, wet winters; harsher in interior
TUR.terrain: high central plateau (Anatolia); narrow coastal plain; several mountain ranges

ALB.name: Albania
ALB.climate: mild temperate; cool, cloudy, wet winters; hot, clear, dry summers; interior is cooler and wetter
ALB.terrain: mostly mountains and hills; small plains along coast

HRV.name: Croatia
HRV.climate: Mediterranean and continental; continental climate predominant with hot summers and cold winters; mild winters, dry summers along coast
HRV.terrain: geographically diverse; flat plains along Hungarian border, low mountains and highlands near Adriatic coastline and islands

CHE.name: Switzerland
CHE.climate: temperate, but varies with altitude; cold, cloudy, rainy/snowy winters; cool to warm, cloudy, humid summers with occasional showers
CHE.terrain: mostly mountains (Alps in south, Jura in northwest) with a central plateau of rolling hills, plains, and large lakes

LUX.name: Luxembourg
LUX.climate: modified continental with mild winters, cool summers
LUX.terrain: mostly gently rolling uplands with broad, shallow valleys; uplands to slightly mountainous in the north; steep slope down to Moselle flood plain in the southeast

BEL.name: Belgium
BEL.climate: temperate; mild winters, cool summers; rainy, humid, cloudy
BEL.terrain: flat coastal plains in northwest, central rolling hills, rugged mountains of Ardennes Forest in southeast

NLD.name: Netherlands
NLD.climate: temperate; marine; cool summers and mild winters
NLD.terrain: mostly coastal lowland and reclaimed land (polders); some hills in southeast

PRT.name: Portugal
PRT.climate: maritime temperate; cool and rainy in north, warmer and drier in south
PRT.terrain: the west-flowing Tagus River divides the country: the north is mountainous toward the interior, while the south is characterized by rolling plains

ESP.name: Spain
ESP.climate: temperate; clear, hot summers in interior, more moderate and cloudy along coast; cloudy, cold winters in interior, partly cloudy and cool along coast
ESP.terrain: large, flat to dissected plateau surrounded by rugged hills; Pyrenees Mountains in north

IRL.name: Ireland
IRL.climate: temperate maritime; modified by North Atlantic Current; mild winters, cool summers; consistently humid; overcast about half the time
IRL.terrain: mostly flat to rolling interior plain surrounded by rugged hills and low mountains; sea cliffs on west coast

NCL.name: New Caledonia
NCL.climate: tropical; modified by southeast trade winds; hot, humid

SLB.name: Solomon Islands
SLB.climate: tropical monsoon; few temperature and weather extremes
SLB.terrain: mostly rugged mountains with some low coral atolls

NZL.name: New Zealand
NZL.terrain: predominately mountainous with large coastal plains

AUS.name: Australia
AUS.climate: generally arid to semiarid; temperate in south and east; tropical in north
AUS.terrain: mostly low plateau with deserts; fertile plain in southeast

LKA.name: Sri Lanka
LKA.climate: tropical monsoon; northeast monsoon (December to March); southwest monsoon (June to October)
LKA.terrain: mostly low, flat to rolling plain; mountains in south-central interior

CHN.name: China
CHN.climate: extremely diverse; tropical in south to subarctic in north
CHN.terrain: mostly mountains, high plateaus, deserts in west; plains, deltas, and hills in east

TWN.name: Taiwan
TWN.climate: tropical; marine; rainy season during southwest monsoon (June to August); persistent and extensive cloudiness all year
TWN.terrain: eastern two-thirds mostly rugged mountains; flat to gently rolling plains in west

ITA.name: Italy
ITA.climate: predominantly Mediterranean; alpine in far north; hot, dry in south
ITA.terrain: mostly rugged and mountainous; some plains, coastal lowlands

DNK.name: Denmark
DNK.climate: temperate; humid and overcast; mild, windy winters and cool summers
DNK.terrain: low and flat to gently rolling plains

GBR.name: United Kingdom
GBR.climate: temperate; moderated by prevailing southwest winds over the North Atlantic Current; more than one-half of the days are overcast
GBR.terrain: mostly rugged hills and low mountains; level to rolling plains in east and southeast

ISL.name: Iceland
ISL.climate: temperate; moderated by North Atlantic Current; mild, windy winters; damp, cool summers
ISL.terrain: mostly plateau interspersed with mountain peaks, icefields; coast deeply indented by bays and fiords

AZE.name: Azerbaijan
AZE.terrain: large, flat Kur-Araz Ovaligi (Kura-Araks Lowland, much of it below sea level) with Great Caucasus Mountains to the north, Qarabag Yaylasi (Karabakh Upland) to the west; Baku lies on Abseron Yasaqligi (Apsheron Peninsula) that juts into Caspian Sea

GEO.name: Georgia
GEO.climate: warm and pleasant; Mediterranean-like on Black Sea coast
GEO.terrain: largely mountainous with Great Caucasus Mountains in the north and Lesser Caucasus Mountains in the south; Kolkhet'is Dablobi (Kolkhida Lowland) opens to the Black Sea in the west; Mtkvari River Basin in the east; fertile soils in river valley flood plains and foothills of Kolkhida Lowland

PHL.name: Philippines
PHL.climate: tropical marine; northeast monsoon (November to April); southwest monsoon (May to October)
PHL.terrain: mostly mountains with narrow to extensive coastal lowlands

MYS.name: Malaysia
MYS.climate: tropical; annual southwest (April to October) and northeast (October to February) monsoons
MYS.terrain: coastal plains rising to hills and mountains

BRN.name: Brunei Darussalam
BRN.terrain: flat coastal plain rises to mountains in east; hilly lowland in west

SVN.name: Slovenia
SVN.climate: Mediterranean climate on the coast, continental climate with mild to hot summers and cold winters in the plateaus and valleys to the east
SVN.terrain: a short southwestern coastal strip of Karst topography on the Adriatic; an alpine mountain region lies adjacent to Italy and Austria in the north; mixed mountains and valleys with numerous rivers to the east

FIN.name: Finland
FIN.climate: cold temperate; potentially subarctic but comparatively mild because of moderating influence of the North Atlantic Current, Baltic Sea, and more than 60,000 lakes
FIN.terrain: mostly low, flat to rolling plains interspersed with lakes and low hills

SVK.name: Slovakia
SVK.climate: temperate; cool summers; cold, cloudy, humid winters
SVK.terrain: rugged mountains in the central and northern part and lowlands in the south

CZE.name: Czech Republic
CZE.climate: temperate; cool summers; cold, cloudy, humid winters
CZE.terrain: Bohemia in the west consists of rolling plains, hills, and plateaus surrounded by low mountains; Moravia in the east consists of very hilly country

ERI.name: Eritrea
ERI.climate: hot, dry desert strip along Red Sea coast; cooler and wetter in the central highlands (up to 61 cm of rainfall annually, heaviest June to September); semiarid in western hills and lowlands
ERI.terrain: dominated by extension of Ethiopian north-south trending highlands, descending on the east to a coastal desert plain, on the northwest to hilly terrain and on the southwest to flat-to-rolling plains

JPN.name: Japan
JPN.climate: varies from tropical in south to cool temperate in north

PRY.name: Paraguay
PRY.climate: subtropical to temperate; substantial rainfall in the eastern portions, becoming semiarid in the far west
PRY.terrain: grassy plains and wooded hills east of Rio Paraguay; Gran Chaco region west of Rio Paraguay mostly low, marshy plain near the river, and dry forest and thorny scrub elsewhere

YEM.name: Yemen
YEM.climate: mostly desert; hot and humid along west coast; temperate in western mountains affected by seasonal monsoon; extraordinarily hot, dry, harsh desert in east
YEM.terrain: narrow coastal plain backed by flat-topped hills and rugged mountains; dissected upland desert plains in center slope into the desert interior of the Arabian Peninsula

SAU.name: Saudi Arabia
SAU.climate: harsh, dry desert with great temperature extremes

ATA.name: Antarctica
ATA.climate: the coldest, windiest, and driest continent on Earth; severe low temperatures vary with latitude, elevation, and distance from the ocean; East Antarctica is colder than West Antarctica because of its higher elevation; Antarctic Peninsula has the most moderate climate; higher temperatures occur in January along the coast and average slightly below freezing; summers characterized by continuous daylight, while winters bring continuous darkness; persistent high pressure over the interior brings dry, subsiding air that results in very little cloud cover
ATA.terrain: about 99% thick continental ice sheet and 1% barren rock, with average elevations between 2,000 and 4,000 m; mountain ranges up to nearly 5,000 m; ice-free coastal areas include parts of southern Victoria Land, Wilkes Land, the Antarctic Peninsula area, and parts of Ross Island on McMurdo Sound; glaciers form ice shelves along about half of the coastline, and floating ice shelves constitute 11% of the area of the continent
ATA.speciesScopeNote: Terrestrial and near-shore examples; Antarctic flowering-plant diversity is very limited.

CYN.name: Northern Cyprus
CYN.climate: Mediterranean: long, hot, dry summers and mild, wetter winters, with cooler conditions in the Kyrenia range.
CYN.terrain: A narrow northern coastal plain rises abruptly into the Kyrenia Mountains; the Mesaoria plain lies to the south.
CYN.speciesScopeNote: Island-wide examples; distributions vary across northern and southern Cyprus.

CYP.name: Cyprus
CYP.climate: temperate; Mediterranean with hot, dry summers and cool winters
CYP.terrain: central plain with mountains to north and south; scattered but significant plains along southern coast

MAR.name: Morocco
MAR.climate: Mediterranean in the north, becoming more extreme in the interior; in the south, hot, dry desert; rain is rare; cold offshore air currents produce fog and heavy dew
MAR.terrain: mountainous northern coast (Rif Mountains) and interior (Atlas Mountains) bordered by large plateaus with intermontane valleys, and fertile coastal plains; the south is mostly low, flat desert with large areas of rocky or sandy surfaces&nbsp

EGY.name: Egypt
EGY.climate: desert; hot, dry summers with moderate winters
EGY.terrain: vast desert plateau interrupted by Nile valley and delta

LBY.name: Libya
LBY.climate: Mediterranean along coast; dry, extreme desert interior
LBY.terrain: mostly barren, flat to undulating plains, plateaus, depressions

ETH.name: Ethiopia
ETH.climate: tropical monsoon with wide topographic-induced variation
ETH.terrain: high plateau with central mountain range divided by Great Rift Valley

DJI.name: Djibouti
DJI.terrain: coastal plain and plateau separated by central mountains

SOL.name: Somaliland
SOL.climate: Mostly arid to semi-arid, with highly variable rainfall and recurring drought; coastal conditions are hot and dry.
SOL.terrain: A hot northern coastal plain rises to the Golis Mountains and an elevated, dry interior plateau.
SOL.speciesScopeNote: Examples reported from Somaliland and the Horn of Africa; some ranges cross regional borders.

UGA.name: Uganda
UGA.climate: tropical; generally rainy with two dry seasons (December to February, June to August); semiarid in northeast
UGA.terrain: mostly plateau with rim of mountains

RWA.name: Rwanda
RWA.climate: temperate; two rainy seasons (February to April, November to January); mild in mountains with frost and snow possible
RWA.terrain: mostly grassy uplands and hills; relief is mountainous with altitude declining from west to east

BIH.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
BIH.climate: hot summers and cold winters; areas of high elevation have short, cool summers and long, severe winters; mild, rainy winters along coast

MKD.name: North Macedonia
MKD.climate: warm, dry summers and autumns; relatively cold winters with heavy snowfall
MKD.terrain: mountainous with deep basins and valleys; three large lakes, each divided by a frontier line; country bisected by the Vardar River

SRB.name: Serbia
SRB.climate: in the north, continental climate (cold winters and hot, humid summers with well-distributed rainfall); in other parts, continental and Mediterranean climate (relatively cold winters with heavy snowfall and hot, dry summers and autumns)
SRB.terrain: extremely varied; to the north, rich fertile plains; to the east, limestone ranges and basins; to the southeast, ancient mountains and hills

MNE.name: Montenegro
MNE.climate: Mediterranean climate, hot dry summers and autumns and relatively cold winters with heavy snowfalls inland
MNE.terrain: highly indented coastline with narrow coastal plain backed by rugged high limestone mountains and plateaus

KOS.name: Kosovo
KOS.climate: influenced by continental air masses resulting in relatively cold winters with heavy snowfall and hot, dry summers and autumns; Mediterranean and alpine influences create regional variation; maximum rainfall between October and December
KOS.terrain: flat fluvial basin at an elevation of 400-700 m above sea level surrounded by several high mountain ranges with elevations of 2,000 to 2,500 m

TTO.name: Trinidad and Tobago
TTO.terrain: mostly plains with some hills and low mountains

SDS.name: South Sudan
SDS.climate: hot with seasonal rainfall influenced by the annual shift of the Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone; rainfall heaviest in upland areas of the south and diminishes to the north
SDS.terrain: plains in the north and center rise to southern highlands along the border with Uganda and Kenya; the White Nile, flowing north out of the uplands of Central Africa, is the major geographic feature of the country; The Sudd (a name derived from floating vegetation that hinders navigation) is a large swampy area of more than 100,000 sq km fed by the waters of the White Nile that dominates the center of the country

properties.name: Sarïr Kalanshiyu ar Ramli al Kabi
